names.legendary: Captain Frostbolt of the Tundra

lore.common: Sprays snow over everyone standing by the trail, especially if they've just built a snowman.
lore.uncommon: Has skis at the front and a rubber track at the back, so it slides and grips at the same time.
lore.rare: Hopped over a snowdrift so high that it landed beyond the pine trees.
lore.epic: Raced across the frozen lake with a hundred others, and the ice fishermen held onto their hats.
lore.legendary: Crossed the whole frozen north in one week, delivering hot soup to every cabin on the way.

names.legendary: Lady Velocity, Fastest on the Coast

lore.common: Revs its engine outside the café so everyone turns to look, then drives off at the speed limit.
lore.uncommon: Is so low to the ground that every speed bump makes it wince.
lore.rare: Scraped its nose on the drive and spent the whole afternoon sulking in the garage.
lore.epic: Raced round the track so fast that the flag waver missed it and waved at the next car.
lore.legendary: Drove the twisty coast road from one end to the other without touching the brakes once.

names.legendary: Old Puffabella, Queen of the Rails

lore.common: Puffs smoke over the platform just as everyone is waving goodbye.
lore.uncommon: Eats shovel after shovel of coal and still says it's hungry.
lore.rare: Whistled so loudly in the tunnel that the bats moved to a different hill.
lore.epic: Pulled the longest train in history up the valley, and the hills echoed with chuffing.
lore.legendary: Pulled the very first train across the new bridge, and still pulls the anniversary train every year.

names.legendary: Big Tankard, the Long Hauler

lore.common: Sloshes round every corner so loudly that you can hear its tummy rumbling.
lore.uncommon: Carries enough fuel to fill every car in the street, and won't share a drop.
lore.rare: Took the roundabout so wide that every car waited in a polite circle.
lore.epic: Drove through the night across three countries to refill every petrol station by morning.
lore.legendary: Has driven a million miles without a single spill, and still has its first air freshener.

names.legendary: Old Faithful Fare of Central Station

lore.common: Turns its light off just as you wave at it in the rain.
lore.uncommon: Has a little meter that ticks up faster than your heartbeat.
lore.rare: Took a shortcut through so many back streets that even the driver got lost.
lore.epic: Got every passenger across the city in rush hour faster than the train.
lore.legendary: Knows every street in the biggest city by heart and has never once used a map.

names.legendary: Hooky Harry, Rescuer of the Stranded

lore.common: Arrives just after you've managed to start your car on your own.
lore.uncommon: Has a big hook on the back that it swings around like a fishing rod.
lore.rare: Winched a car out of a ditch so smoothly that the driver didn't spill their coffee.
lore.epic: Towed every broken-down car off the motorway on the snowiest night of the year.
lore.legendary: Has rescued so many stranded drivers that the motorway services keep a parking space with its name on it.

names.legendary: Tilla, Waker of the Soil

lore.common: Shakes the soil so hard that the earthworms complain to the farmer.
lore.uncommon: Rakes up every weed in the field and leaves them in neat little piles.
lore.rare: Churned up a field so fine that it looked like chocolate cake.
lore.epic: Prepared every field in the valley for spring in one week, and the seeds cheered.
lore.legendary: Has woken the same soil every spring for fifty years, and the field grows better each time.

names.legendary: Old Baleworth, Roller of Summer

lore.common: Spits out a bale right where the farmer wanted to park.
lore.uncommon: Ties every bale with string so tight that nobody can untie it.
lore.rare: Swallowed a whole row of hay and rolled out a bale as big as a car.
lore.epic: Baled every field on the farm in one sunny day, and the fields were dotted with giant cotton reels.
lore.legendary: Rolled a hay bale so big that the cows used it as a climbing frame all winter.

names.legendary: Ploughella, Turner of the Earth

lore.common: Hits every stone in the field with a loud clang, then carries on as if nothing happened.
lore.uncommon: Is followed by a cloud of seagulls hoping it will turn up a worm.
lore.rare: Turned over a field so straight that the farmer used it as a ruler.
lore.epic: Ploughed every field in the county before the first frost, and the crows ate like kings.
lore.legendary: Has turned over the same farm's soil for a hundred years and found three Roman coins and a lost teapot.

names.legendary: Old Sowsworth, Planter of Plenty

lore.common: Drops seeds on the path as well as the field, so the pigeons follow it everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Plants seeds in perfect rows, so the field looks like a striped jumper.
lore.rare: Planted a whole field before lunch, and the farmer had nothing left to do all afternoon.
lore.epic: Sowed every field in the valley in one spring week, and the hills turned green together.
lore.legendary: Has planted so many fields that it once sowed a whole village's wheat and the bread was the best in years.

names.legendary: Big Blade Brenda of the Blizzard

lore.common: Clears the road and buries your driveway behind a wall of snow.
lore.uncommon: Sprinkles grit on the road like salt on chips.
lore.rare: Pushed through a snowdrift as tall as a house without slowing down.
lore.epic: Cleared every road in town in one snowy night, and the schools stayed open.
lore.legendary: Kept the mountain pass open through the worst blizzard in a century, and the milk lorry got through.

names.legendary: Old Rusty Reggie, Pride of the Farm

lore.common: Drives down the lane at walking speed and every car behind has to follow.
lore.uncommon: Flings mud from its huge back wheels all over the farmyard.
lore.rare: Pulled a lorry out of a flooded ditch, then went straight back to work.
lore.epic: Rumbled through the village with every tractor in the county for the harvest parade.
lore.legendary: Has worked the same farm for seventy years and starts first time every morning, even in the snow.

names.legendary: Grand Ascensia of the Hillside

lore.common: Creeps up the hill so slowly that people jog past it on the steps.
lore.uncommon: Is pulled up the slope by a long cable, with its twin coming down the other way.
lore.rare: Climbed a hill so steep that the passengers had to hold onto their hats.
lore.epic: Carried the whole town up to the castle for the fireworks in one evening.
lore.legendary: Has gone up and down the same cliff for a hundred years and never once lost its cable.

names.legendary: Grand Junction, Pride of the Attic

lore.common: Goes round and round the loft all weekend while the grown-ups pretend it's for the children.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into a tiny tunnel and takes ages to come out the other side.
lore.rare: Came off the rails on the bend and crashed into a tiny cow.
lore.epic: Ran through the whole model village with every light on, and the tiny people waved.
lore.legendary: Has been running round the same attic for forty years and still keeps perfect time.

names.legendary: Grand Unirail of the Future City

lore.common: Glides above the street and blocks the sun from every café table below.
lore.uncommon: Runs on just one rail, as if it's balancing on a tightrope.
lore.rare: Glided between the skyscrapers so quietly that the pigeons didn't move.
lore.epic: Carried every visitor round the theme park in one day, and the queues disappeared.
lore.legendary: Has run round the same city for fifty years and still looks like it's from the future.

names.legendary: Little Puffkin, Engine of the Nursery

lore.common: Clatters round its wooden track and falls off at the same bend every time.
lore.uncommon: Joins on with magnets and comes apart whenever the dog walks past.
lore.rare: Was pushed under the sofa and came back out three weeks later covered in fluff.
lore.epic: Carried every toy in the playroom round the track in one long line.
lore.legendary: Has been pushed round wooden tracks by four generations of children and still has its painted smile.

names.legendary: Grand Intercity, Pride of the Line

lore.common: Arrives two minutes late every day, then leaves one minute early.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its carriages so much that everyone's tea slops into the saucer.
lore.rare: Roared through the tunnel so loudly that the sheep on the hill above looked down.
lore.epic: Carried the whole city to the seaside on a bank holiday, and the beach was full by ten.
lore.legendary: Has run between the same two cities for a hundred years and still sounds its horn at every level crossing.

names.legendary: Old Highseat of the White Peaks

lore.common: Swings in the wind just as you're trying to sit down with your skis.
lore.uncommon: Leaves your feet dangling in the cold air all the way up.
lore.rare: Dropped a skier's glove into the snow below, and the next skier caught it.
lore.epic: Carried every skier up the mountain on the busiest day of the year, and the slopes were full by nine.
lore.legendary: Has carried a million skiers up the same mountain and never once forgotten to slow down at the top.

names.legendary: Grand Bubblina of the Alps

lore.common: Stops halfway up the mountain and sways, just to make everyone nervous.
lore.uncommon: Is a little glass bubble on a cable, so you can see the whole valley under your feet.
lore.rare: Floated over the forest so high that the eagles flew underneath it.
lore.epic: Carried every hiker up the mountain before the storm came in.
lore.legendary: Has floated over the same valley for fifty years, and every family photo in the village was taken inside it.

names.legendary: Old Clanger, Queen of the Rails

lore.common: Dings its bell at you while you're standing exactly on its tracks.
lore.uncommon: Gets its wheels stuck in the grooves in the road and doesn't care one bit.
lore.rare: Sparked on its overhead wire so brightly that it lit up the whole street.
lore.epic: Carried the whole town to the parade on the busiest day, and still ran on time.
lore.legendary: Has trundled down the same main street for a hundred years and knows every shopkeeper by their wave.

names.legendary: Old Slipway Sid of the Harbour

lore.common: Goes in the wrong direction every time the car reverses.
lore.uncommon: Holds the boat so snugly that it looks like a giant cradle.
lore.rare: Backed too far down the slipway and got its wheels wet up to the axle.
lore.epic: Launched every boat in the harbour for the summer regatta, one after another.
lore.legendary: Has carried the same little boat to the same beach for forty summers.

names.legendary: Grand Carrier of the Long Road

lore.common: Carries ten new cars, and every one of them gets a bird dropping before arriving.
lore.uncommon: Stacks cars on two levels like a moving car park.
lore.rare: Ducked under a low bridge with only a finger's width to spare.
lore.epic: Delivered a car to every showroom in the country in one week.
lore.legendary: Has carried a hundred thousand new cars and never once scratched a single one.

names.legendary: Old Tipsy, Carrier of Rubble

lore.common: Tips up at the worst moment and spills rubble across the drive.
lore.uncommon: Clanks behind the truck like a grumpy tin can on a string.
lore.rare: Carried away the rubble from a whole old house in one load.
lore.epic: Dumped so much rubble at the building site that it made a little mountain for the diggers to play on.
lore.legendary: Has carried enough rubble to build a new hill, and the children sled on it every winter.

names.legendary: Long Flatbed Larry

lore.common: Flaps its loose straps on the motorway like it's waving at everyone.
lore.uncommon: Has no sides, so everything it carries is held on with ropes and hope.
lore.rare: Carried a whole wooden house, and the house waved at passing cars.
lore.epic: Drove with a wide load through the town, and every lamp post had to lean out of the way.
lore.legendary: Has carried boats, sheds, houses and once a whole bandstand to their new homes without losing a screw.

names.legendary: Lady Saddlebrook of the Pony Club

lore.common: Thumps and bumps all the way down the lane because the pony inside is dancing.
lore.uncommon: Has a little hay net inside so the horse can snack on the journey.
lore.rare: Refused to let the pony out until it had finished its hay.
lore.epic: Led a convoy of horse trailers to the county show, and the lanes smelled of hay for a week.
lore.legendary: Has carried every winning pony in the county to the show for thirty years.

names.legendary: Big Timberella of the Pines

lore.common: Drops bark on the road behind it all the way through town.
lore.uncommon: Carries a whole stack of logs that smells like a pine forest.
lore.rare: Carried logs down a mountain road so steep that the brakes squealed for an hour.
lore.epic: Brought down a whole forest's worth of timber in one week to build a new town.
lore.legendary: Has driven the same mountain road for thirty years and never once lost a single log.

names.legendary: Mega Mauler, Crusher of Cars

lore.common: Rolls over the car parked next to it at the show, and pretends it didn't see.
lore.uncommon: Has tyres taller than a grown-up, so it climbs over everything.
lore.rare: Jumped over a row of old buses and landed with a bounce.
lore.epic: Crushed every old car at the stadium show, and the crowd went wild.
lore.legendary: Did a backflip in a monster truck, landed on all four wheels and honked its horn.
